findings.title: Previous successful result can be recorded as current inflight_event
findings.condition: After one successful sample, a subsequent sample raises before return. No per-attempt result reset occurs, so locals() still contains the previous result. May span axis transition.
findings.impact: Failure context can misidentify a previous event as the failing attempt. Does not show incorrect successful science values; no execution was performed.
findings.required_future_correction: Initialize per-attempt current result, record current axis/trial_id and acquired/unavailable status, distinguish last committed prefix from inflight context.
required_future_artificial_regressions: angle failure and save failure context
findings.related_digest_scope: digest.update precedes stream.emit and completed counter. Failure trace may include generated but uncommitted event. Bind trace and committed chain/file scopes explicitly.

findings.existing_scope: Receipt shape/contract digest, fresh claim ID, one-use object, retry/resume controls are implemented; external authority is not implemented.
findings.needed_scope: Durable atomic admission and user approval/source release binding, with spent claim plus failure preservation even after admission but before output directory creation.
